text:
Priya: Hey team — I just noticed my 7/31 paycheck still shows CA state tax withheld but I’ve been working from my new NV address since 7/12. I submitted the HR address update on 7/10 and attached lease on 7/11. Can payroll confirm which state was used and whether I need a correction?

Evan (Payroll): Hi Priya — can you share the payrun id or paystub link? Also did you mark yourself as remote full-time or a temporary trip? NV is non-income-tax so this matters.

Priya: Paystub link: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/priya-0731.png. Payrun id payrun-20240731-02. I changed my address in Workday to NV on 2024-07-10 and marked status change as "permanent move".

Sam (People Ops): @Evan FYI we approved the address change on 7/10 at 16:05 and updated benefits enrollment. I also added note about payroll sync.

Evan (Payroll): Looks like the payroll sync for that payrun executed on 7/15 and pulled address snapshot from HR on 7/09 because of an earlier nightly snapshot. Two issues: (1) address update was processed after the HR snapshot used by payroll, (2) the employee tax residency workflow still requires a manual state-change step when moves are within two weeks of a payrun. I'll open PR ticket and propose an off-cycle gross/net correction if applicable.

PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2024-910 opened. Action: reprocess payrun, calculate retro tax delta, issue off-cycle refund for net tax withheld, attach residency memo for audit. ETA triage 4 business hours.

Rita (Manager): Thanks — Priya is short on funds this week. If we can do an expedited off-cycle that would help.

Evan (Payroll): We can prioritize. Quick note re: W-2 impact — if the reprocess reduces state tax withheld for the year we will adjust year-to-date with a reversing entry and typically no W-2C unless withholding was reported and transmitted to FTB already. We'll confirm after reprocess.

Priya: Appreciate the clarification. Please ping when the off-cycle posts. Also can we add a short checklist so future mid-month moves aren't missed?

Sam (People Ops): Agreed. I'll add a 3-step checklist: 1) update HR address, 2) notify manager, 3) confirm payroll state-change before the payrun snapshot cutoff. Will share in #people-ops and link it to the relocation checklist.

PayrollBot: PR-2024-910 status update: reprocess completed 2024-08-01T10:22Z. Result: CA withheld $231.46 on payrun; corrected state withholding 0. Off-cycle net refund issued 2024-08-01 (ref OC-8401). Ticket closed by Evan 2024-08-01T14:12Z.

Priya: Off-cycle received. All good, thanks everyone.

Evan (Payroll): Closing note for audit: attached residency memo and sync logs to PR-2024-910. If YTD filings require follow-up we'll reach out about a potential W-2C.
